title: [Decision] AGENTS.md is 82 KB with no table of contents and 28% fleet-operations narrative, CONTRIBUTING hands every rule to it, and there is no PR template: how a human contributor is meant to onboard
body:
Ruled: 6417533492 · letter A · 2026-10-26T13:44Z

Filing gate ②: a maintainer-only decision. Maintainer, 2026-10-26, verbatim: 「完整的评估本项目， 还有哪些可以优化的地方。包括 ci 和文档」 then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue，需要决策的立为决策卡。」 and 「低优先级的先不考虑」. Batch-of: 19 (repository evaluation 2026-10-26, `session_019a9XCWsbMFp75REzthE6cs`; 9 decision cards + 10 execution cards). Reader: the director seat presents this card in a decision batch; after the ruling the lane named under "After the ruling" dispatches. ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: REST list (439 issues), grep `AGENTS.md` → 4 hits: #26035 (open, dispatched: 32 files prescribe retired objectui pin scripts, AGENTS.md among them), #25712 (open: ui/AGENTS.md nesting), #25919 (open, dispatched, ruled A: narrative cost — its AGENTS.md reading is the ui tree's 630-line file; ruling 「规范核心与事故史分家，注释写不变量不写事故史，存量不横扫」), #17161 (open program: CLAUDE.md is a pointer to AGENTS.md). grep `CONTRIBUTING|PR template` → 0. The root AGENTS.md's shape and the human onboarding path are not on any card. **New.**

## 维护者速读

根 `AGENTS.md` 1,117 行、82,823 字节、17 个 H2、59 个 ⛔，没有目录。「多代理工作纪律」一节 318 行占 28%，内容是 stash、合并队列、车队 bot、页脚字节等席位运维；「Build & Test」143 行多数是 typecheck 棘轮内部实现。`CONTRIBUTING.md` 本身只有 158 行、写得对，但所有真规则都甩给 AGENTS.md（第 12 行「两者冲突以 AGENTS.md 为准」），并使用未解释的术语如「Clause-② 声明」（第 100 行，定义在 AGENTS.md 第 1087 行）。没有 `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` 和 issue 模板，CONTRIBUTING 第 120–129 行的检查清单在 PR 时不强制。两条已有裁决相关：`CLAUDE.md` 写「一套指令只在一处维护，不在别处复述」；#25919 你裁了「规范核心与事故史分家」。拆分 AGENTS.md 与「一处维护」表面冲突，所以是你的决定。请裁：**A** AGENTS.md 保留全部约束性规则并加目录，把「多代理工作纪律」与「Build & Test」的机制说明段迁出到 `docs/agents/*.md`（AGENTS.md 留一行规则 + 指针），CONTRIBUTING 加「人类最小规则」8 条小节（Zod-first、命名、无 prettier、worktree、changeset + Clause-②、spec 再生成、发布归属、英文产物），加 PR 模板镜像该清单；**B** 只加目录与 CONTRIBUTING 小节 + PR 模板，AGENTS.md 正文不迁；**C** 现状。选 A / B / C？

## Governing text

- `CLAUDE.md`: "One instruction set, maintained in one place: ⛔ no rule, hook roster or guardrail is restated here, and none is added here later." — a rule against restating rules, not against moving a rule's explanation.
- `AGENTS.md:11-16`: "This file carries principles, binding rules and lookup tables — rules only. A rule states what to do and what never to do, in one executable sentence; it carries no incident narrative".
- #25919 ruling A (comment 6386217274): 规范核心与事故史分家；存量不横扫.
- #17161: CLAUDE.md stays a pointer to AGENTS.md in every repo.
- Prime Directive 14: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.github/workflows/**` are Tier H; a PR template under `.github/` is not in the register (the register is `.github/workflows/**`), so it is Tier-free unless you say otherwise.

## Premises

- P1 — size and shape: `wc -lc AGENTS.md` → 1117 lines, 82823 bytes; `grep -n '^## ' AGENTS.md` → 17 headings (Communication 23 · Build & Test 36 · Prime Directives 179 · Multi-agent working discipline 325 · Monorepo Layout 643 · Protocol Domains 669 · Kernel 694 · Documentation Guardrails 705 · Context Routing 777 · Skills 803 · Patterns 814 · Route & surface ownership 841 · Degradation log levels 913 · Startup registry reads 1002 · Writing a --self-test 1049 · Post-Task Checklist 1073 · Edit Sizing 1115).
- P2 — `ls .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE* .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE 2>&1` → none.
- P3 — `grep -n 'Clause' CONTRIBUTING.md` → line 100 uses the term; `grep -n 'Clause-②' AGENTS.md | head -1` → line 1087 defines it.
- P4 — the file's own rule mostly holds: 0 ISO dates and 0 `#NNNN` citations in AGENTS.md (`grep -cE '#[0-9]{4,5}' AGENTS.md` → 0), but three "ruling record <id>" citations (lines 130, 132, 531) that a reader cannot resolve.

## One-sentence problem

A person who wants to open their first pull request is told to read 82 KB with no table of contents, a quarter of which is about how a fleet of agents shares a git stash, and nothing at PR time checks the eight rules they can actually break.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | TOC; move mechanism prose of §Multi-agent and §Build & Test to `docs/agents/` leaving one-sentence rules + pointers; "Human minimum" section in CONTRIBUTING; `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` mirroring it. | AGENTS.md shrinks by an estimated 40%; rules stay in one place (the explanation moves, not the rule); humans get an eight-rule on-ramp. Governed-prose gates (`check:pm-governed-prose`, `check-published-list-mirrors`) must keep passing — the dev runs them. | skills lane (AGENTS.md is theirs) · 2 PRs Tier H (AGENTS.md; CONTRIBUTING + template non-governed) · precedent: #25919's in-flight PR for ui/AGENTS.md — read its +/− |
| B | TOC + CONTRIBUTING section + PR template; AGENTS.md body untouched. | Smaller change; the 82 KB stays the first read. | 1 PR Tier H (TOC edit) + 1 non-governed |
| C | Nothing. | — | 0 |

## Business meaning

- A: the rulebook is a rulebook and the operations manual is a manual.
- B: a map at the door of the same building.
- C: the door stays where it is.

## 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**：北极星定义的用户是「第三方开发者，人验收」；CONTRIBUTING 是他们进门的第一页。今天它说「规则都在 AGENTS.md」，而 AGENTS.md 没有目录。
- **项目长远合理性**：`CLAUDE.md` 的「一处维护」防的是规则复述；A 迁走的是机制说明（为什么、怎么量到的），规则句留在 AGENTS.md——与 #25919「规范核心与事故史分家」同一方向，是把那条裁决用到根文件。
- **防 AI 犯错**：席位每个会话都加载 AGENTS.md；82 KB 里 28% 与多数任务无关，是每次会话的强制 token 成本（#25919 的原话）。更短的规则文件让席位更难漏读约束。
- **创业阶段不扩散**：不加门禁；PR 模板是一个静态文件；`docs/agents/` 两份文件承接迁出的段落，不是新的规则源。

## Recommendation

**A.** 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

Confidence gaps: which paragraphs of §Multi-agent are "rule" vs "mechanism" is a judgement the dev makes paragraph by paragraph; the PR's 维护者速读 lists every moved paragraph so you can pull any back. #26035 is editing the same file now; A serializes behind it.

## After the ruling

- A: skills seat dispatches PR 1 (AGENTS.md + `docs/agents/`, Tier H) after #26035 lands; devx seat PR 2 (CONTRIBUTING + template).
- B: skills seat one small Tier H PR; devx seat PR 2.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：规则句留一处，机制说明迁出，与 #25919 裁决同向。
② 实际业务拉动：人类贡献者进门第一页把他们送进 82 KB 无目录文件。
③ 防 AI 犯错：更短的规则文件每会话都加载，漏读约束的概率随长度降。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：零新门禁；模板是静态文件。
Prior rulings read: AGENTS.md,one place,narrative,CONTRIBUTING → 4 hits (#25919 A, #17161, #26035, #25712); none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack
